# Which brokerage lets you keep the most?

> Free real estate brokerage split calculator for agents. Compare up to three brokerages by what you net after the split, cap, transaction and monthly fees, franchise royalty and referral fees, and see the deal count where each plan wins. Runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
